pages.text: Each fuel gives the stream its own shape (spread / speed / sparks per tick):$(br2)$(li)$(item)Gasoline$(): 15 / 1 / 3$(li)$(item)Diesel$(): 7 / 2 / 3. Tight and far-reaching.$(li)$(item)Kerosene$(): 10 / 1.3 / 4

$(li)$(item)Naphtha$(): 20 / 0.8 / 1. The most economical.$(li)$(item)LPG$(): 35 / 0.6 / 16. A short, wide cloud of fire.$(li)$(item)Napalm$(): 20 / 1.8 / 15. Fast and dense.$(li)$(item)Molten Slag$(): 15 / 0.3 / 15. Heavy and short.

A higher spread fans the sparks out, a higher speed throws them further, and more sparks per tick means more fire but a tank that empties faster, since the fuel used each tick follows the number of sparks.
These fuel types are data-driven: a modpack can add fuels or change these values with a datapack.
